QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_CT_ASM` is defined only when `MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM` is set and `__GNUC__` is available (armcc5 is excluded).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says MBEDTLS_CT_ASM is defined within constant_time_impl.h from MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM plus compiler predefined macros (`__GNUC__`), so it is derived. It does not say outright that the macro isn't set in mbedtls_config.h, but the mechanism is stated.
